verdict.rationale: vLLM's own feature list explicitly claims disaggregated prefill and decode (plus encode), which is the exact capability this story asks for. The support is a single feature-list line, with no configuration guide, connector/KV-transfer details, or hands-on corroboration of large-scale performance gains. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on setting up disaggregated prefill/decode, details on KV-cache transfer between instances, independent or hands-on evidence of optimized large-scale serving.

support.subject: As a developer, I can disaggregate prefill and decode phases for optimized large-scale serving
